written: 2026-10-17, before the band scan finished and before any of these analyses was run
target: L9/N3688, + pole. Current label (H3): the word 'nerve' and nerv- forms, strongest in the psychological sense (strain, composure, courage), with known offshoots: anatomical 'nerve', the 신경 token in names, and 'strong' after violent context.
goal: Try hard to show this neuron is NOT monosemantic: that it has a second, unrelated job somewhere in its activation range.

D1_corpus_strong.what: Every token in 6M corpus tokens where the pole reaches >= 0.3 of its corpus max. Automatically check for a nerve morpheme (nerv, nerf, Nerv, нерв, 神经/神經, 신경, عصب, nervi) within 3 tokens either side; send every token without one to blind annotation.
D1_corpus_strong.prediction: >= 90% of strong activations have a nerve morpheme within 3 tokens.
D1_corpus_strong.disproof_if: The unexplained strong activations form a coherent unrelated theme with >= 10 instances that is not one of the known offshoots.

D2_weak_bands.what: 30 random contexts (one per window) from each band 0.05–0.1, 0.1–0.2, 0.2–0.3 and 0.3–0.5 of max, annotated blind into: A psychological 'nerve' word; B other 'nerve' word (anatomical, names, other forms); C no nerve word but strain / composure / courage / anxiety meaning; D unrelated; E unclear.
D2_weak_bands.prediction: A+B fall as activation falls, while C stays visible (local generalization of the same job). D is under 50% in the 0.2–0.3 band. D contexts in the weak bands share no single coherent theme.
D2_weak_bands.disproof_if: Any band has a single coherent theme outside A–C making up >= one third of its contexts.

D3_large_leak_search.what: A leak search over a large natural bank: ~500 random corpus sentences plus every 'should fire' sentence written for the 48 web neurons, with every sentence containing a nerve morpheme removed. SciPy differential evolution over 3-sentence passages (same manifold as the probe), goal: maximise the pole.
D3_large_leak_search.prediction: The maximum stays below 0.4, and whatever drives it is composure / fortitude / strain meaning or an orthographic look-alike, not an unrelated concept.
D3_large_leak_search.disproof_if: A passage with no nerve morpheme reaches >= 0.5, or >= 0.3 through an unrelated concept that replicates in 3 of 3 new sentences written for that concept.
